verdict.rationale: Sift lets developers send their own business data through several channels: user lifecycle events via the REST Events API, custom events and fields for actions the standard events don't cover, and business decisions via the Decisions API. The JS snippet and iOS/Android SDKs collect client-side data, and historical data can be backfilled because 'Sift gets smarter the more data it has about your business.' The founder also describes JS-collected signals versus REST events feeding detection. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of device-fingerprint collection, an explicit statement that custom fields directly influence model scoring, and independent hands-on corroboration that custom signals tailor scores.
